item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Sleep. Your evening's already structured toward it — relaxation, wind-down, a fixed bedtime. That only works if you protect it. Don't let the day's noise bleed into that window. When the wind-down slot comes up tonight, actually stop and do it, phone down, lights low. One action: honor the bedtime on your calendar tonight, no negotiating with yourself when it hits.
